messages:
Nora (PM): Heads-up: post-launch triage for v1.3. We have three customer blockers, two polish asks, and an EAP-funded enhancement. Need quick prioritization for next two sprints.

Alex (Eng): Can we treat blockers by customer exposure and rollout risk? Some fixes touch core cache layer.

Devon (CS): Blocker list: 1) BetaCorp timeout on batching -> blocks checkout (high); 2) internal telemetry gap causing missed alerts (medium); 3) visual jitter on small screens reported by several users (low).

Mika (Design): Visual jitter is a straightforward CSS tweak + acceptance tests. Low engineering time.

Nora (PM): Proposal: - Hotfix sprint next week: BetaCorp timeout + telemetry gap. Reserve 5 dev-days. - Funded EAP enhancement (configurable batch timeout) accepted if contract signed; treat as expedited work. - Polish (jitter + copy) into following sprint. - Defer noncritical backlog to Q2.

Alex (Eng): ETA: timeout fix ~2d, telemetry ~2d, CSS tweak <0.5d. Configurable batch timeout (EAP) needs design + 3d eng. Risk: timeout touches router code, needs canary.

OpsBot: Canary policy reminder: all hotfix merges require a 6-hour staging validation + 2% traffic canary by default.

Devon (CS): BetaCorp is willing to test canary traffic. They asked for a rollback window and a short doc.

Mika (Design): I'll make a small UX doc for EAP and polish ACs.

Nora (PM): Decision rubric for this release: 1) Customer blocking > ship hotfix. 2) Funded EAP as long as contract signed and resource lead available. 3) Polishes batch if effort <=1d each. 4) Anything >3d schedule into next milestone.

Alex (Eng): I'll own the timeout fix and the telemetry patch. Will open PRs with feature flags for canary.

Devon (CS): I'll coordinate BetaCorp testing and the customer comm.

Nora (PM): Action items: Alex (timeout + telemetry), Mika (ACs + docs), Devon (customer test + contract check), Nora (update roadmap + sprint plan). Re-eval Thursday AM. :thumbsup:

Alex (Eng): :thumbsup:

Mika (Design): :thumbsup: creating tickets now

Devon (CS): :thumbsup: pinging BetaCorp

Nora (PM): Thanks all — small focused sprint, should keep momentum and clear high-impact items.
